solution.p: We have to substitute {{\frac{6}{7}}} in for x and simplify each side. The left side simplifies to {{\frac{93}{28}}} and the right side simplifies to {{\frac{101}{28}}}\text{.} Since these are not equal, {{\frac{6}{7}}} is not a solution to {3x+{\frac{3}{4}}}={5x-{\frac{19}{28}}}\text{.}
